scenes.heading: The symbol is constructed
scenes.visual: A barely visible graphite dot becomes two compass circles. A central V is constructed with measured angles. The approved oVo mark resolves from geometric guides; the small growth detail receives a single muted-blue ink pass. The final wordmark typesets underneath.
scenes.motion: Pencil guides -> drawn circular arcs -> ink shape -> gentle fade of construction geometry; no particle effects, logo bounce or glow.
scenes.sound: Quiet compass point and paper friction; music begins with a held piano/felt-note texture.
scenes.status: Approved brand direction; use finalized master logo artwork only

scenes.heading: The research question
scenes.visual: On a clean manuscript spread, a medical question is written at left. On the right, restrained index lines emerge toward individually labeled study records, clinical research, and biological knowledge; use accurate source categories rather than fabricated journal titles.
scenes.motion: Write-on serif headline; measured hairlines extend in two stages; small page numbers and diagram references fade in.
scenes.sound: One subdued page turn and understated ticking strokes.
scenes.status: General research framing; no claim of implementation

scenes.heading: The evidence trail
scenes.visual: A precise vertical provenance diagram forms: Disease -> Typed claim -> Evidence relationship -> Study / source -> Provenance. A fine blue rule traces the path; show a tasteful crop of the REAL Evidence Explorer UI, if verified and available.
scenes.motion: Sequential line draws; labels reveal individually; a restrained camera push <=2%.
scenes.sound: Five soft mechanical ink clicks, never sci-fi UI beeps.
scenes.status: Existing public-alpha functionality documented in README

scenes.heading: Scientific uncertainty
scenes.visual: Four calibrated research lanes labeled SUPPORTS, CONTRADICTS, INCONCLUSIVE, UNASSERTED. Under each, a fine ink line is marked with a different endpoint. A note reads: "A claim is not proof."
scenes.motion: Labels and line plots draw sequentially; no gamified certainty gauge or single universal confidence score.
scenes.sound: Pencil stroke, slight harmonic tension, then resolution.
scenes.status: Based on documented evidence direction and provenance semantics

scenes.heading: Compare and question
scenes.visual: Two to five condition dossiers line up like architectural elevations; common genes, phenotypes, pathway terms and explicitly missing data are differentiated. Integrate a real verified Compare V2 interface crop; annotate NOT RECORDED vs KNOWN ABSENT accurately.
scenes.motion: Two specimen-like columns slide into register; translucent tracing paper reveals common and differing areas.
scenes.sound: Soft registering-paper sound; music expands subtly.
scenes.status: Existing Compare V2 functionality; do not show fictional app features as shipped

scenes.heading: Scale, with context
scenes.visual: A fine grid of 10,404 miniature cells accumulates to fill one rectangular sheet; a few cells receive blue indicators to distinguish deeper curation from catalog breadth. An explicit note prevents the viewer from equating catalog size with expert curation.
scenes.motion: Count rolls 0 → 10,404 in ~2.5 seconds; grid populates with quiet sequential reveal; hold the qualification long enough to read.
scenes.sound: Subtle quickening pen taps, then fall to silence for the caveat.
scenes.status: Repository README snapshot dated 2026-08-22; re-verify before release

scenes.heading: From platform to ambition
onscreen: And the next question is bigger.
scenes.visual: Transition from the research registry to a precise working-notebook spread: a provenance graph becomes a model sketch, a simple documented equation, simulation output axes, then a registered computational experiment. Cross-section and mechanism drawings should be scientifically legible and not falsely passed off as results.
scenes.motion: One continuous line travels through four nodes; each sheet mechanically flips into the next; the in-development label remains anchored.
scenes.sound: Original restrained strings enter, with soft drafting instrument sounds.
scenes.status: Aspirational roadmap; explicitly not currently shipped

scenes.heading: Open and inspectable
scenes.visual: Cut to real GitHub repository detail, versioned source code, visible tests or documentation; make the real package name/repo path legible. No fake green CI badges, invented test outcomes, or live SaaS screenshot.
scenes.motion: Precision snap zoom onto source file/version header; return to wide paper composition.
scenes.sound: Music resolves; one dry keyboard/camera-cut sound.

scenes.heading: NosoVolution reveal and invitation
onscreen: A more connected way to investigate biology.
scenes.visual: The oVo emblem appears as the final ink drawing above the custom NosoVolution wordmark; subtle construction arcs and paper fiber remain, then settle. Small footer: "Public alpha · Research use only". Avoid implying the envisioned simulation ecosystem is already deployed.
scenes.motion: No dramatic flash: 0.6 s mark reveal, 0.5 s wordmark, CTA holds ≥2.4 s. End on a still frame.
scenes.sound: Simple original resolving piano chord with quiet natural tail.
scenes.status: Brand launch + existing open-source foundation; repo is still nosograph
